application_cases_withdrawal_check.name: application_cases_withdrawal_check
application_cases_withdrawal_check.value: ("application_cases"."withdrawn_on" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_reason" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorder_user_id" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorder_name" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorded_at" IS NULL) OR ("application_cases"."withdrawn_on" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorder_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorder_name" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."withdrawal_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL)

application_cases_summary_author_check.name: application_cases_summary_author_check
application_cases_summary_author_check.value: ("application_cases"."summary_author_user_id" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."summary_author_name" IS NULL AND "application_cases"."summary_recorded_at" IS NULL) OR ("application_cases"."summary_author_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."summary_author_name" IS NOT NULL AND "application_cases"."summary_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL)

material_requested_check.name: material_requested_check
material_requested_check.value: ("material_versions"."requested_minor_units" IS NULL) = ("material_versions"."requested_currency" IS NULL) AND ("material_versions"."requested_minor_units" IS NULL OR ("material_versions"."requested_minor_units" >= 0 AND "material_versions"."requested_currency" = 'EUR'))

material_submission_check.name: material_submission_check
material_submission_check.value: ("material_versions"."submission_version" IS NULL AND "material_versions"."applicant_organization" IS NULL AND "material_versions"."submitted_on" IS NULL AND "material_versions"."project_period" IS NULL) OR ("material_versions"."submission_version" IS NOT NULL AND "material_versions"."submission_version" > 0)

organizations_demo_check.name: organizations_demo_check
organizations_demo_check.value: ("organizations"."kind" = 'standard' AND "organizations"."demo_expires_at" IS NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" IS NULL) OR ("organizations"."kind" = 'demo' AND "organizations"."demo_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" IS NOT NULL AND "organizations"."demo_seed_version" > 0)

organization_invitations_access_check.name: organization_invitations_access_check
organization_invitations_access_check.value: ("organization_invitations"."purpose" = 'provisioning' AND "organization_invitations"."administration" = 'owner' AND "organization_invitations"."role" = 'program_manager') OR ("organization_invitations"."purpose" = 'team' AND "organization_invitations"."administration" IN ('none', 'administrator') AND "organization_invitations"."role" IN ('member', 'program_manager', 'reviewer'))

recommendation_allocation_check.name: recommendation_allocation_check
recommendation_allocation_check.value: "recommendation_versions"."allocation_minor_units" >= 0 AND "recommendation_versions"."allocation_currency" = 'EUR' AND (("recommendation_versions"."position" = 'Defer' AND "recommendation_versions"."allocation_minor_units" = 0) OR ("recommendation_versions"."position" IN ('Fund', 'Fund with a condition') AND "recommendation_versions"."allocation_minor_units" > 0))

recommendation_author_check.name: recommendation_author_check
recommendation_author_check.value: "recommendation_versions"."author_name" IS NOT NULL OR ("recommendation_versions"."author_user_id" IS NULL AND "recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_interface" IS NULL AND "recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_client_id" IS NULL)

recommendation_author_provenance_check.name: recommendation_author_provenance_check
recommendation_author_provenance_check.value: ("recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_interface" IS NULL AND "recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_client_id" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_interface" = 'web' AND "recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_client_id" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_interface" = 'mcp' AND "recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_client_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("recommendation_versions"."author_provenance_client_id") > 0)

recommendation_provenance_check.name: recommendation_provenance_check
recommendation_provenance_check.value: ("recommendation_versions"."provenance_interface" IS NULL AND "recommendation_versions"."provenance_client_id" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_versions"."provenance_interface" = 'web' AND "recommendation_versions"."provenance_client_id" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_versions"."provenance_interface" = 'mcp' AND "recommendation_versions"."provenance_client_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("recommendation_versions"."provenance_client_id") > 0)

review_assignment_identity.name: review_assignment_identity
review_assignment_identity.value: "review_assignments"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'submitted') OR ("review_assignments"."reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "review_assignments"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

reviewer_draft_position_check.name: reviewer_draft_position_check
reviewer_draft_position_check.value: "reviewer_drafts"."position" is null or "reviewer_drafts"."position" in ('Fund', 'Fund with a condition', 'Defer', 'Decline')

assessment_versions_position_check.name: assessment_versions_position_check
assessment_versions_position_check.value: "assessment_versions"."position" is null or "assessment_versions"."position" in ('Fund', 'Fund with a condition', 'Defer', 'Decline')

assessment_versions_amount_check.name: assessment_versions_amount_check
assessment_versions_amount_check.value: ("assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" is null) = ("assessment_versions"."amount_currency" is null) and ("assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" is null or ("assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" >= 0 and "assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" <> 'NaN' and "assessment_versions"."amount_currency" = 'EUR'))

assessment_versions_position_amount_chec.name: assessment_versions_position_amount_check
assessment_versions_position_amount_chec.value: "assessment_versions"."position" is null or "assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" is null or ("assessment_versions"."position" in ('Decline', 'Defer')) = ("assessment_versions"."amount_minor_units" = 0)

assessment_versions_recorder_check.name: assessment_versions_recorder_check
assessment_versions_recorder_check.value: (("assessment_versions"."recorder_user_id" is null) = ("assessment_versions"."recorder_name" is null)) and (("assessment_versions"."recorder_user_id" is null) = ("assessment_versions"."recorder_recorded_at" is null))

assessment_versions_recorder_provenance_.name: assessment_versions_recorder_provenance_check
assessment_versions_recorder_provenance_.value: ("assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_interface" is null and "assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("assessment_versions"."recorder_user_id" is not null and (("assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_interface" = 'web' and "assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_interface" = 'mcp' and "assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is not null and length(btrim("assessment_versions"."recorder_provenance_client_id")) > 0)))

review_requests_recorder_check.name: review_requests_recorder_check
review_requests_recorder_check.value: (("review_requests"."recorder_user_id" is null) = ("review_requests"."recorder_name" is null)) and (("review_requests"."recorder_user_id" is null) = ("review_requests"."recorder_recorded_at" is null))

review_requests_recorder_provenance_chec.name: review_requests_recorder_provenance_check
review_requests_recorder_provenance_chec.value: ("review_requests"."recorder_provenance_interface" is null and "review_requests"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("review_requests"."recorder_user_id" is not null and (("review_requests"."recorder_provenance_interface" = 'web' and "review_requests"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("review_requests"."recorder_provenance_interface" = 'mcp' and "review_requests"."recorder_provenance_client_id" is not null and length(btrim("review_requests"."recorder_provenance_client_id")) > 0)))

review_requests_closed_by_check.name: review_requests_closed_by_check
review_requests_closed_by_check.value: (("review_requests"."closed_by_user_id" is null) = ("review_requests"."closed_by_name" is null)) and (("review_requests"."closed_by_user_id" is null) = ("review_requests"."closed_by_recorded_at" is null))

review_requests_closed_by_provenance_che.name: review_requests_closed_by_provenance_check
review_requests_closed_by_provenance_che.value: ("review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_interface" is null and "review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("review_requests"."closed_by_user_id" is not null and (("review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_interface" = 'web' and "review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_client_id" is null) or ("review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_interface" = 'mcp' and "review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_client_id" is not null and length(btrim("review_requests"."closed_by_provenance_client_id")) > 0)))

review_requests_closed_cause_check.name: review_requests_closed_cause_check
review_requests_closed_cause_check.value: "review_requests"."closed_cause" is null or ("review_requests"."closed_by_user_id" is not null and "review_requests"."closed_cause" = 'application_withdrawn')

workspace_file_read.name: workspace_file_read
workspace_file_read.using:
(SELECT merit_scope()->>'kind') IN ('workspace', 'assignment')
  AND organization_id IN (SELECT merit_workspace_ids())

workspace_file_insert.name: workspace_file_insert
workspace_file_insert.withCheck:
(SELECT merit_scope()->>'kind') IN ('workspace', 'assignment')
  AND organization_id IN (SELECT merit_workspace_ids())
    AND uploaded_by = (SELECT merit_scope()->>'userId')
